title.zh: Crypto industry reacts after Clarity Act fails Senate vote
title.en: Crypto industry reacts after Clarity Act fails Senate vote

current_state.zh: The U.S. Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act, a major crypto market structure bill, dealing a significant blow to the industry's push for a durable statutory framework and prolonging regulatory uncertainty.
current_state.en: The U.S. Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act, a major crypto market structure bill, dealing a significant blow to the industry's push for a durable statutory framework and prolonging regulatory uncertainty.
